long_biography.plain_text:
Angelakos comes from a fifth-generation Greek shipping family whose modern business developed around cargo-vessel management. That background gave him familiarity with maritime transport and technical operations before he moved into an adjacent market. He has described existing family expertise as the platform that helped him identify an opportunity in luxury maritime tourism.

Through his current company, he has directed a substantial investment programme and the construction of a larger commercial-charter fleet. His operating approach combines technical and financial supervision with structured recruitment and seafarer development. The company aims to pair Greek maritime experience with internationally competitive hospitality and management standards.
